mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4% sustain labor market strength, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth surpasses 3% YoY, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in post-shock recovery regimes, a rebound in retail sales (RSAFS) above $700B signals renewed consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of post-shock instances when RSAFS > $700B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate (as a proxy for real interest rates) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the spread is below 1%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when spread < 1% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200k new jobs signals labor market strength, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 1% MoM and GDP (GDPC1) growth surpasses 2% QoQ, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
